incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK usage in web module
incidents.description: The web module uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3) for object storage, which needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage SDK.
incidents.recommendation: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Update AwsS3Config and AwsS3Service to use Azure Blob Storage client.

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK usage in worker module
incidents.description: The worker module uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3) for object storage, which needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage SDK.
incidents.recommendation: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Update AwsS3Config and S3FileProcessingService to use Azure Blob Storage client.

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS credentials in web module
incidents.description: AWS credentials (accessKey and secretKey) are hardcoded in configuration using StaticCredentialsProvider, which is a security risk and incompatible with Azure Managed Identity.
incidents.recommendation: Replace StaticCredentialsProvider with Azure DefaultAzureCredential for managed identity-based authentication. Remove hardcoded credentials from configuration files.

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS credentials in worker module
incidents.description: AWS credentials (accessKey and secretKey) are hardcoded in configuration, which is a security risk and incompatible with Azure Managed Identity.
incidents.recommendation: Replace StaticCredentialsProvider with Azure DefaultAzureCredential for managed identity-based authentication. Remove hardcoded credentials from configuration files.

incidents.title: S3Client usage in AwsS3Service
incidents.description: The AwsS3Service class uses S3Client for all storage operations (listObjects, uploadObject, getObject, deleteObject). This needs to be migrated to BlobServiceClient.
incidents.recommendation: Replace S3Client with BlobServiceClient and update all S3-specific operations to use Azure Blob Storage APIs.

incidents.title: S3Client usage in S3FileProcessingService
incidents.description: The S3FileProcessingService class uses S3Client for thumbnail processing operations. This needs to be migrated to BlobServiceClient.
incidents.recommendation: Replace S3Client with BlobServiceClient and update all S3-specific operations to use Azure Blob Storage APIs.

incidents.title: ListObjectsV2Request usage
incidents.description: The listObjects method uses AWS S3-specific ListObjectsV2Request, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage listing APIs.
incidents.recommendation: Replace ListObjectsV2Request with BlobContainerClient.listBlobs() method from Azure SDK.

incidents.title: PutObjectRequest usage
incidents.description: The uploadObject method uses AWS S3-specific PutObjectRequest, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage upload APIs.
incidents.recommendation: Replace PutObjectRequest with BlobClient.upload() method from Azure SDK.

incidents.title: GetObjectRequest usage
incidents.description: The getObject method uses AWS S3-specific GetObjectRequest, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage download APIs.
incidents.recommendation: Replace GetObjectRequest with BlobClient.downloadContent() or BlobClient.openInputStream() method from Azure SDK.

incidents.title: DeleteObjectRequest usage
incidents.description: The deleteObject method uses AWS S3-specific DeleteObjectRequest, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage delete APIs.
incidents.recommendation: Replace DeleteObjectRequest with BlobClient.delete() method from Azure SDK.

incidents.title: GetUrlRequest usage
incidents.description: The generateUrl method uses AWS S3-specific GetUrlRequest for URL generation, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage URL APIs.
incidents.recommendation: Replace GetUrlRequest with BlobClient.getBlobUrl() method from Azure SDK.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ dependency in web module
incidents.description: The web module uses spring-boot-starter-amqp for RabbitMQ messaging, which needs to be migrated to Azure Service Bus.
incidents.recommendation: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus. Update messaging configuration to use Azure Service Bus.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ dependency in worker module
incidents.description: The worker module uses spring-boot-starter-amqp for RabbitMQ messaging, which needs to be migrated to Azure Service Bus.
incidents.recommendation: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus. Update messaging configuration to use Azure Service Bus.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ configuration in web module
incidents.description: The RabbitConfig class configures RabbitMQ queues and message converters, which needs to be replaced with Azure Service Bus configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Create a new ServiceBusMessagingConfig class to configure Azure Service Bus queues and message converters using ServiceBusProcessorClient.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ configuration in worker module
incidents.description: The worker module RabbitConfig class configures RabbitMQ queues and listeners, which needs to be replaced with Azure Service Bus configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Create a new ServiceBusMessagingConfig class to configure Azure Service Bus message processors using ServiceBusProcessorClient.

incidents.title: RabbitTemplate usage in AwsS3Service
incidents.description: The AwsS3Service uses RabbitTemplate to send messages, which needs to be replaced with ServiceBusSenderClient.
incidents.recommendation: Replace RabbitTemplate with ServiceBusSenderClient and update message sending logic to use Service Bus APIs.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ Queue bean configuration
incidents.description: The Queue bean creates a durable RabbitMQ queue, which needs to be replaced with Azure Service Bus queue configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Remove Queue bean and configure Azure Service Bus queue using ServiceBusAdministrationClient or Azure Portal.

incidents.title: Jackson2JsonMessageConverter for RabbitMQ
incidents.description: The Jackson2JsonMessageConverter is RabbitMQ-specific and needs to be replaced with Azure Service Bus message serialization.
incidents.recommendation: Use ServiceBusMessage with custom serialization or ObjectMapper for JSON message conversion in Service Bus.

incidents.title: SimpleRabbitListenerContainerFactory configuration
incidents.description: The SimpleRabbitListenerContainerFactory is RabbitMQ-specific and needs to be replaced with Azure Service Bus processor configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Replace with ServiceBusProcessorClient configuration using DefaultAzureCredential for authentication.

incidents.title: RabbitMQ connection factory usage
incidents.description: The configuration uses RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory, which needs to be replaced with Azure Service Bus client configuration.
incidents.recommendation: Replace ConnectionFactory with ServiceBusClientBuilder configured with DefaultAzureCredential.

incidents.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials in web properties
incidents.description: RabbitMQ credentials (username and password) are hardcoded in application.properties, which is a security risk.
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity for Service Bus authentication. Remove hardcoded credentials from configuration files.

incidents.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials in worker properties
incidents.description: RabbitMQ credentials (username and password) are hardcoded in application.properties, which is a security risk.
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity for Service Bus authentication. Remove hardcoded credentials from configuration files.

incidents.title: PostgreSQL connection string in web module
incidents.description: The PostgreSQL connection string uses localhost, which needs to be updated for Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
incidents.recommendation: Update connection string to use Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint. Configure SSL connection and use Managed Identity for authentication.

incidents.title: PostgreSQL connection string in worker module
incidents.description: The PostgreSQL connection string uses localhost, which needs to be updated for Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
incidents.recommendation: Update connection string to use Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint. Configure SSL connection and use Managed Identity for authentication.

incidents.title: Spring Boot version
incidents.description: The project uses Spring Boot 3.2.1. Consider upgrading to the latest stable version for better Azure integration and security patches.
incidents.recommendation: Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.4.x or latest LTS version for improved Azure Spring Cloud integration and latest security patches.

incidents.title: Missing Application Insights integration
incidents.description: The application does not have Azure Application Insights integration for monitoring and telemetry.
incidents.recommendation: Add spring-cloud-azure-starter-monitor dependency and configure Application Insights for distributed tracing and monitoring.

incidents.title: AWS S3 bucket configuration in web module
incidents.description: The configuration uses AWS S3 bucket name, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage container name.
incidents.recommendation: Replace aws.s3.bucket with azure.storage.container-name and update configuration to use Azure Blob Storage naming conventions.

incidents.title: AWS S3 bucket configuration in worker module
incidents.description: The configuration uses AWS S3 bucket name, which needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage container name.
incidents.recommendation: Replace aws.s3.bucket with azure.storage.container-name and update configuration to use Azure Blob Storage naming conventions.

incidents.title: AWS region configuration in web module
incidents.description: The configuration uses AWS region, which needs to be replaced with Azure location/region.
incidents.recommendation: Replace aws.region with azure.location (e.g., eastus, westus2) for Azure resource configuration.

incidents.title: AWS region configuration in worker module
incidents.description: The configuration uses AWS region, which needs to be replaced with Azure location/region.
incidents.recommendation: Replace aws.region with azure.location (e.g., eastus, westus2) for Azure resource configuration.

incidents.title: Missing Azure Spring Cloud BOM
incidents.description: The project does not include Azure Spring Cloud BOM for managing Azure SDK versions.
incidents.recommendation: Add spring-cloud-azure-dependencies BOM to dependencyManagement section to ensure compatible Azure SDK versions.

incidents.title: Missing health check endpoints
incidents.description: The application should expose health check endpoints for Azure App Service or Container Apps.
incidents.recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-actuator dependency and configure health endpoints for Azure platform integration.

incidents.title: SQL logging enabled in production
incidents.description: JPA SQL logging is enabled (spring.jpa.show-sql=true), which may impact performance in production.
incidents.recommendation: Move SQL logging to a development-specific profile and disable in production. Use Application Insights for production monitoring.

incidents.title: DDL auto-update in production configuration
incidents.description: Hibernate ddl-auto is set to 'update', which is risky for production environments.
incidents.recommendation: Use 'validate' or 'none' for production and implement proper database migration tools like Flyway or Liquibase.

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage
recommendations.description: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK in both web and worker modules. Update all storage operations to use BlobServiceClient and BlobClient APIs.

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace RabbitMQ with Azure Service Bus in both web and worker modules. Update messaging configuration to use ServiceBusProcessorClient and ServiceBusSenderClient.

recommendations.title: Implement Azure Managed Identity
recommendations.description: Replace all hardcoded credentials with Azure Managed Identity authentication using DefaultAzureCredential. Remove sensitive credentials from configuration files.

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
recommendations.description: Update database connection strings to use Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Configure SSL and implement Managed Identity authentication.

recommendations.title: Add Azure Application Insights
recommendations.description: Integrate Azure Application Insights for distributed tracing, monitoring, and telemetry collection.

recommendations.title: Upgrade Spring Boot and Add Azure BOM
recommendations.description: Upgrade Spring Boot to the latest stable version and add Azure Spring Cloud BOM for better Azure integration.
